# Method: (1) erase sites = original ink (L < 0.60 x 21px median) that Z_9's version lightened by >12 and that is not ink there any more; clustered with 3px dilation, >=15 px. (2) In CURRENT, per 16x16 tile, old-ink px >3 px from current ink: mean L/local-median vs the same mask shifted +-7 px (8 shifts) -> delta and z; flag delta < -0.05 and z < -2.5. Calibrated on the known C04-008 ghost (flags it, delta -0.134 z -5.3). (3) flat fill: high-pass (sigma 1.5) std in erased px vs nearby untouched skin, flag < 0.6. (4) every site viewed at 4x and 6x plain, autocontrast and 5x high-pass (C - gauss2), with the original ink edge overlaid. ghost_px = old-ink px < 0.85 x local skin. Clean-erase controls: C04-015 v004 (0 px <0.85, outline step 1.91 vs ring 1.93), C15-003 v006 (0 px, 1.94 vs 2.67), C04-010 v005 (old-ink median 68 vs skin 63).
# Fix method (V_1): restore ORIGINAL/base pixels everywhere outside the new ink mask, texture-clone (from adjacent lit skin of the same frame) only over the old ink, never a flat fill; single save.
